title: UI icons / Usage

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Keep small interface symbols readable and predictable so people can act without decoding unnecessary visual variation.
strategic_value: Consistent sizing, text alignment and monochrome treatment can connect IBM interfaces while reducing visual competition.
demonstration: A sizing table, text-and-icon comparisons, clearance diagram, third-party marks and interface examples explain use at small scales.
practical_value: Select the supplied icon size, center it beside text and retain adequate touch clearance.

content_islands.name: Sizing and text pairs
content_islands.spec: Begin with the four-size table and Plex pairings, followed by correct and incorrect size and baseline examples.

content_islands.name: Alignment and clearance
content_islands.spec: Place optical-centering specimens before the 44px target diagram and spacing comparison.

content_islands.name: Color and third-party marks
content_islands.spec: Use monochrome examples and borrowed marks to separate color consistency from third-party artwork permissions.

content_islands.name: Applications
content_islands.spec: Close with interface, device and dashboard examples showing icons in actual layouts.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction explicitly connects sparse, strategic icon use to reduced cognitive load.
reference_purposes.Expression: Monochrome outlined icons share characteristic corners and Plex-adjacent proportions.
reference_purposes.Application: The page demonstrates icon-to-text alignment, touch padding and integration into interfaces.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source requires original 16, 20, 24 or 32px sizes, 44px-or-larger touch targets and monochrome icons; third-party marks must not be visually altered.

ingredient.name: UI icon sizing and clearance
ingredient.role: Keep actions identifiable and touch targets usable.
ingredient.application: Use icons at their supplied sizes; center them alongside text. Provide at least 44px touch targets, adding surrounding padding when the icon is smaller.
ingredient.scope: UI icons in interfaces. The 44px minimum is the touch target, not a requirement that the artwork itself be 44px.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
